name: Peeled & Steamed Zucchini (Courgette)
whyItWorks: Once the dark green outer peel is shaved off, the pale tender interior of zucchini is over 94% water with soft, immature seeds that melt during cooking. It produces virtually zero digestive residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a vegetable peeler to peel off all green skin. Slice into rounds and steam or simmer in broth for 8–10 minutes until translucent and fork-soft.
watchOuts: Always peel the outer green skin during flares, as raw unpeeled zucchini skin is tough insoluble fiber.
